hypothesis: C_30 ≅ C_2 × C_3 × C_5 is algebraically available at p=31. H=1 Model C has one phase register and can realize F (30-gon) or Q (C_15 × C_2), not three independent clocks. H=3 supplies three complex heads. A 3-torus attractor is three heads whose windings have gcd(k,30) a permutation of {15,10,6} (image orders 2,3,5), decoded by CRT with no neural readout.
architecture: Model C, H=3, Xavier, no dlog init. Same interaction as H=1; three independent 2-D embedding tables concatenated before W.
protocol: held_row a0=p-1, P=1024, 8000 Adam steps, lr=3e-3, seed=0, float32 domain_acc>=1.0. Do not relax the gate. Do not initialize from discrete log.
not_3_torus: A faithful 30-gon (gcd=1) is Family F, including when other heads are unused.
Class-2 C_15 × C_2 (gcd=2 plus radius) is Q, already found at H=1.
Packing C_3 × C_5 as one 15-clock is not T^3.

certificate.C1_domain_exact: float32 domain accuracy 1 on all 900 pairs
certificate.C2_winding_triple: the three heads have gcd(k_eff,30) a permutation of {15,10,6}
certificate.C3_crt_decoder: neural-free: read j mod 2,3,5 from the three snapped phases, CRT to j in 0..29, output g^j mod 31. Product uses addition of the three coordinates. Must be 100% exact.
certificate.C4_drop_one_factor: Replace any one factor's per-residue coordinates by independent uniform draws in that Z/dZ (not a global translation: on C_2 a global +1 cancels in the product). CRT must fail.
certificate.C5_snap: replacing each head by its fitted cyclotomic circle (exact roots at k_eff, fitted phi and mean radius) keeps C3 exact

predictions.P1_exact_exists: H=3 held-row at p=31 produces at least one domain-exact net (capacity).
predictions.P2_f_like_present: Some exact nets have at least one faithful head (gcd=1). Those are F-like, not 3-torus.
predictions.P3_torus_not_guaranteed: A certified 3-torus family may appear and may not. Presence is the measurement. Do not treat a high H=3 exact rate as a 3-torus.
predictions.P4_h1_cannot: H=1 cannot satisfy C2 (only one gcd). Already observed at p=31: 271 F + 48 Q. No retrain.
predictions.P5_do_not_add_heads: If n_certified=0, do not raise H to 4, do not dlog-init, do not loosen exactness or R^2.

success_gate: The run completes under the locked protocol and scores P1–P5. Scientific 3-torus claim requires n_certified>0. Zero is a valid miss.
decoder_sanity_before_training: CRT decoder must be 100% on synthetic embeddings e_h(a)=exp(2πi k_h log_g(a)/30) for (k2,k3,k5)=(15,10,6) before any SGD.
